faqs.a: Ocala and nearby towns like Belleview, Silver Springs, Dunnellon, Summerfield and The Villages. Call and we will confirm your address.

faqs.q: How much does house cleaning cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of your home and the type of cleaning. Send us a few details and you get a clear price before any work starts.

faqs.q: Do you do move out and rental cleaning?
faqs.a: Yes. We clean empty homes for move ins and move outs, and reset rentals and Airbnbs between guests.

faqs.q: What is the difference between standard and deep cleaning?
faqs.a: A standard clean keeps a tidy home fresh. A deep clean goes further, with baseboards, vents, appliances and other spots that build up over time.

faqs.q: Can I set up a regular cleaning schedule?
faqs.a: Yes. Many homes choose weekly, biweekly or monthly visits. We will build a schedule around your routine.
